subject: missed-call-follow-up
title: How a missed-call follow-up pilot works, start to finish
description:
What you send and what you get back in the two-week missed-call pilot: lead follow-up for home services businesses that lose leads to missed calls.

Missed-Call and Web-Inquiry Follow-Up List: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

#homeservices #leadfollowup

See the sample report and the pilot terms: https://hq.amberoneai.com/offers/missed-call-follow-up?src=youtube&utm_campaign=missed-call-how-it-works
narration: Here's how the missed-call pilot works, start to finish.
You send a call log export from your phone provider, your website form submissions, and the replies you already made.
You get every unanswered lead, most urgent first, repeat callers grouped, and a draft reply for each, for you to send.
There's no connection to your phone system, and Amber never contacts your customers.
One location, your last 30 days of calls, then two weekly refreshes. The price and terms are on the page.
